asset.name: IconAdapter
asset.description: Binds the icon registry to a concrete icon set through individual imports and normalized geometry metadata, so the set is swappable without touching any component.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: A second satisfier for the icon port alongside the template-seeded registry: the foundation defines the contract and default, this binds a specific set. Individual imports are mandatory — a broad icon-package import is one of the largest avoidable bundle costs.
